title: Create student marks and attendance tracking system

requirements.text: Create a backend data model to store student information including name, roll number, class/grade, and contact details
acceptanceCriteria: Student records can be created with unique identifiers
Student data persists across canister upgrades
Students can be retrieved by ID or roll number

requirements.text: Implement backend functionality to record and retrieve student marks for different subjects and exams
acceptanceCriteria: Marks can be recorded with subject name, exam date, and score
Marks are associated with specific students
Historical marks data is maintained
Marks can be queried by student, subject, or date range

requirements.text: Implement backend functionality to track daily attendance records for students
acceptanceCriteria: Attendance can be marked as present, absent, or late for each date
Attendance records are associated with specific students
Attendance history is preserved
Attendance can be queried by student or date range

requirements.text: Create a frontend interface to add, view, edit, and delete student records
acceptanceCriteria: Form to add new students with all required fields
List view showing all students
Ability to edit existing student information
Ability to remove student records
Search or filter functionality to find specific students

requirements.text: Create a frontend interface to record and view student marks
acceptanceCriteria: Form to enter marks for a student with subject and exam details
Display marks history for individual students
Show marks summary or report cards
Visual indicators for performance (e.g., grades, percentages)

requirements.text: Create a frontend interface to mark and view student attendance
acceptanceCriteria: Interface to mark attendance for all students on a given date
Calendar or date picker to select attendance date
View attendance history for individual students
Display attendance statistics (percentage present, absent days)

requirements.text: Design a professional, education-focused visual theme with warm, welcoming colors and clear typography that reflects an academic coaching environment
acceptanceCriteria: Consistent color scheme across all pages
Typography is readable and professional
Layout is clean and organized for easy navigation
Design conveys trust and academic professionalism

constraints: All backend logic must be implemented in a single Motoko actor
Use React with TypeScript for frontend
nonGoals: Automated grade calculation or GPA systems

required: Educational coaching center logo with books and graduation cap motif (logo.dim_200x200.png)
Hero banner image showing students studying in a coaching environment (hero-banner.dim_1200x400.png)
